caseName: Federal Communications Commission v. NextWave Personal Communications Inc.
caseNameFull: Federal Communications Commission v. NextWave Personal Communications Inc. and Arctic Slope Regional Corp. v. NextWave Personal Communications Inc.

opinions.text: C. A. D. C. Cir. [Certiorari granted, 535 U. S. 904.] Motion of the Acting Solicitor General for divided argument granted. Motion of Creditors of NextWave Personal Communications Inc. for leave to participate in oral argument as amici curiae and for divided argument granted.
